name: marketplacecommerceanalytics
description: Provides AWS Marketplace business intelligence data on-demand

subcommands.name: generate-data-set
subcommands.description: Given a data set type and data set publication date, asynchronously publishes the requested data set to the specified S3 bucket and notifies the specified SNS topic once the data is available.

options.name: --data-set-publication-date
options.description: The date a data set was published.

options.name: --role-name-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Role with an attached permissions policy to interact with the provided AWS services

options.name: --destination-s3-bucket-name
options.description: The name (friendly name, not ARN) of the destination S3 bucket

options.name: --destination-s3-prefix
options.description: (Optional) The desired S3 prefix for the published data set, similar to a directory path in standard file systems.

options.name: --sns-topic-arn
options.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the SNS Topic that will be notified when the data set has been published or if an error has occurred

options.name: --customer-defined-values
options.description: (Optional) Key-value pairs which will be returned, unmodified, in the Amazon SNS notification message and the data set metadata file.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
